info.title: Access hosted Frontend API
info.description: The realm-scoped routes of the hosted pages and embedded components (TN-133), served under the realm's host and under /realms/{slug}. A planned route answers 501 not-yet-served.

post.summary: Starts a flow; its kind is login unless the body names another.

get.summary: The flow's current step.

post.summary: Submits one method of the current step.
Starts a step-up for an exact action and reason (X29).
What a sign-in link would do, before it is confirmed.
Confirms a sign-in link on the device that asked for it.

get.summary: This device's sign-in.
Where the account is signed in.

post.summary: Signs out on this device.
Signs out on every device; delegations remain.
Starts adding an authenticator app.
Confirms an authenticator app with its first code.
Makes new recovery codes, shown once.
The owner's password hash and authenticator app seeds, after a fresh step-up (TN-86).
Records the owner's "I saved them" for the newest recovery codes (TN-59).
Starts adding a passkey.
Finishes adding a passkey.

get.summary: The person's channel and topic preferences.
The documents the person accepted and those awaiting acceptance.

post.summary: Accepts one version of a document.

get.summary: The account's security history, 90 days, address prefixes only.
Whether the account is scheduled for deletion, and when.

delete.summary: Cancels a scheduled deletion inside its window.

get.summary: The person's export and deletion requests.

post.summary: Asks for the person's export: idp.account.export (OP-153 m.3 (cc)).
Opens a guest sign-in for a client that allows guests (OP-153 m.3 (k)).
Starts changing the e-mail address after a step-up (OP-153 m.3 (i)).
Confirms the new address with its out-of-band code.
Starts a recovery attempt; the answer is the same whether or not an account exists (OP-153 m.3 (d)).

get.summary: A recovery attempt's state.

post.summary: Submits one proof to a recovery attempt.
Extends the attempt's recovery contact codes once by 24 hours (OP-153 m.3 (d)).
Opens the credential-only sign-in of a reset intent (TN-61).

get.summary: The account's recovery contacts, at most three.

post.summary: Makes a cross-device link code, never sent by e-mail (OP-153 m.3 (d)).

get.summary: An invitation's organization and role, as text; a scanner's GET does not consume it.

post.summary: Accepts an invitation (OP-153 m.3 (o)).

get.summary: The organizations the person belongs to.

post.summary: Creates an organization: party_register and idp.org.create (OP-153 m.3 (b)).

get.summary: Home realm discovery by organization id (TN-3, TN-98): the target to confirm, only when the organization turned it on and holds a verified domain; the realm's sign-in policy still decides.

post.summary: Asks an organization's administrators for access.

get.summary: The open ownership handovers the person receives or, as an owner, may cancel (TN-91).

post.summary: The recipient's own contribution to an ownership handover: the ExerciseID of its accept_root contribute Exercise; it still waits for its delay and the owner's signed completion (TN-91, L0-META-20).

delete.summary: Cancels an open ownership handover: any owner or the recipient, until it commits; the record is kept (TN-91).

post.summary: A ward asks its guardian for consent to what the purpose digest names; the guardian is told through Relay and the request lapses after 72 hours. Silence is not consent (E53, E47).

get.summary: What a consent answers now, to its ward or guardian: allow, deny or require_action (E47).

post.summary: The guardian approves or declines once, before the request lapses (E53, E47).

get.summary: Starts sign-in with a social provider (OP-153 m.3 (l)).
The provider's redirect back; checked in the back end.
The account's linked sign-ins.

post.summary: Links another sign-in after re-authentication (OP-153 m.3 (m)).

delete.summary: Ends a linked sign-in; the record is kept.

post.summary: Combines two re-authenticated accounts, irreversibly (OP-153 m.3 (m)).

get.summary: The apps the person shares claims with (OP-153 m.3 (z)).

post.summary: Shares the claims a waiting third-party request asks for (OP-153 m.3 (z)).

delete.summary: Stops sharing claims with an app.

post.summary: What a waiting third-party request asks the person to share (OP-153 m.3 (z)).
The S1 draft a waiting third-party request's typed bounds open (§8.17.4.3, X27).

get.summary: This realm's halves of the account's cross-realm bindings (§12.1.3).

post.summary: Offers to bind the account to one in another realm, after re-authentication (§12.1.3, TN-65).
Commits this realm's half with the other realm's offer token (§12.1.3).
Commits the offering realm's half with the accepting realm's token (§12.1.3).
Ends another device's sign-in; names the device Instance whose instance.terminate the page then signs (OP-153 m.3 (y)).
Ties this sign-in to the device (DBSC, OP-153 m.3 (y)).
Refreshes a device-tied sign-in.
Receives CSP reports, 100 a minute per realm (OP-153 m.3 (t)).

get.summary: The realm's branding record as the hosted pages draw it: name and logo URL (TN-106, OP-153 m.3 (t)).
The realm's own texts for unprotected message keys, by locale and key, which the hosted pages draw in place of Access's (X35, OP-153 m.22 (k)).

post.summary: The person chose not to share: the waiting request goes back to the app with access_denied (X-L8).

get.summary: The account's sign-in methods for S11: password, passkeys, authenticator apps, recovery codes (TN-99, OP-148).

delete.summary: Removes a sign-in method after a recent re-authentication; never the last one (TN-68).

put.summary: Sets or changes the password after a recent re-authentication; other sign-ins end (TN-50).

get.summary: The RFC 8628 verification page, a trusted surface of its own: the person enters the code a device shows (OP-154 m.3 (p)).

post.summary: What a user code asks for: the client's name, the scope, and the IP prefix and country the request came from; five wrong codes wait 15 minutes (OP-154 m.3 (p)).
Approves or declines a user code with the person's AAS; the token it releases is DPoP-bound (OP-154 m.3 (p)).

get.summary: The person's agents and what each is connected to: sponsor, status, authority and connected accounts (OP-154 m.3 (e), (t)).
The person's connected accounts for agents, each with its upstream, scopes and state; never a token (OP-154 m.3 (t)).

post.summary: Starts connecting an upstream account after the person's AAS for that client (AS-M15, OP-154 m.3 (t)).

get.summary: One connected account: upstream, scopes, state (`active` or `needs_reconnect`); never a token.

delete.summary: Disconnects an account: the TokenSet ends and is revoked upstream where it can be; nothing is deleted (OP-73).

post.summary: Releases an upstream token only for an allowed Exercise whose PEP is the calling registered executor Instance, once per step, expiring by the horizon (G59, EI-26, OP-154 m.3 (t)).

get.summary: The Web Bot Auth key directory: the Ed25519 keys bound to live agent Instances; revoking an Instance removes its key (RFC 9421, OP-154 m.3 (u)).

post.summary: What the consent screen of a client the realm did not register shows: hostnames, the client's own claims, the resource, the scopes, the grant.issue the person's device Instance signs, and the CSRF token (§11.6, AS-M14, OP-154 m.3 (k)).
Keeps the consent record once the named Exercise is the person's own allowed grant.issue, then sends the browser back to the request (EI-18, P58).
The person declined: the waiting request goes back to the client with access_denied and nothing is kept (X-L8).

get.summary: The did:web document of a person or agent: verification keys and service endpoints; an identifier, never authority (OP-154 m.3 (aa)).

NotYetServed.description: The route is declared and not served yet (OP-153 m.4).
